Revision History

Overview

This page tracks revisions to the Service X public API. Each row corresponds to a versioned release.

Revisions

VersionDateChanges
1.02026-01-15Initial release
1.12026-03-22Added POST /events endpoint
2.02026-05-10Breaking: renamed id to resource_id

Migration example

curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v2/events \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"resource_id": "abc"}'
  • Backward-compatible aliases retained until v3.0
  • Old endpoint returns HTTP 410 after 2026-12-31
